note: cve_id -> the function(s) that must be present for the CVE to apply. Used by reachability triage to down-rank (never drop) a CVE when none of its vulnerable functions are observable in the matched component's binaries. Keyed by canonical NVD product. Absence of a symbol is a hint, not proof (inlining / stripping / static linking can hide it), so it only lowers confidence.
